name: gpio_setup
description: Set the pin mode, 0 input, 1 output, 2 open-drain (pin,mode)->()

name: gpio_set_pull
description: Set the pull resistor, 0 none, 1 up, 2 down (pin,pull)->()

name: gpio_write
description: Set an output low or high (pin,level)->()

name: gpio_high
description: Set an output high (pin)->()

name: gpio_low
description: Set an output low (pin)->()

name: gpio_toggle
description: Toggle an output (pin)->()

name: gpio_read
description: Read an input, 0 low, 1 high (pin)->(level)

name: gpio_write_mask
description: Set the outputs of a port whose mask bits are set to the bits of values (port,mask,values)->()

name: gpio_read_mask
description: Read the inputs of a port whose mask bits are set, the other bits are 0 (port,mask)->(values)

name: pwm_setup
description: Start PWM on a pin at a frequency in Hz with duty 0, returns the frequency reached or 0 (pin,frequency)->(actual)

name: pwm_duty
description: Set the duty cycle to value/max (pin,value,max)->()

name: pwm_pulse
description: Set the high time in microseconds (pin,microseconds)->()

name: pwm_stop
description: Stop PWM on a pin and drive it low (pin)->()

name: uart_setup
description: Set up a port, baud rate / 10, config 0 is 8N1 (port,baud,config)->()

name: uart_available
description: Number of received bytes waiting to be read (port)->(count)

name: uart_read
description: Read one received byte, -1 if there is none (port)->(byte)

name: uart_write
description: Send one byte (port,byte)->()

name: uart_write_available
description: Number of bytes that can be sent without waiting, 0 while busy (port)->(count)

name: uart_read_str
description: Read up to max received bytes into a string (port,dest_index,max)->(count)

name: uart_read_mem
description: Read up to max received bytes into memory, one per cell (port,address,max)->(count)

name: uart_write_str
description: Send length bytes of a string from start (port,src_index,start,length)->(count)

name: uart_write_mem
description: Send length bytes from memory, one per cell (port,address,length)->(count)

name: i2c_setup
description: Set up a port as controller, bus clock in kHz (port,speed)->()

name: i2c_probe
description: Check if a device acknowledges its address, 0 or negative status (port,device)->(status)

name: i2c_write_byte
description: Send one byte to a device (port,device,byte)->(count)

name: i2c_read_byte
description: Read one byte from a device (port,device)->(byte)

name: i2c_write_reg
description: Write a byte to a device register (port,device,reg,byte)->(count)

name: i2c_read_reg
description: Read a byte from a device register (port,device,reg)->(byte)

name: i2c_write_mem
description: Send length bytes from memory, one per cell (port,device,address,length)->(count)

name: i2c_read_mem
description: Read length bytes into memory, one per cell (port,device,address,length)->(count)

name: i2c_write_str
description: Send length bytes of a string from start (port,device,src_index,start,length)->(count)

name: i2c_read_str
description: Read length bytes into a string (port,device,dest_index,length)->(count)

name: i2c_write_read_mem
description: Send bytes from memory, then read into memory after a repeated start (port,device,src_address,src_length,dest_address,dest_length)->(count read)
